label: atg
text: An ATG measures the tank level. OneSync supports twelve ATGs.

label: ratg
text: This is the R-ATG Ultrasonic. The RATG Capacitive uses a different measuring method.

label: du
text: Each DU is a dispensing unit. SMART#C works with single-DU and double-DU fuelling.

label: bos
text: In offline mode, OneSync connects to the BOS card over Zigbee and LoRaWAN.

label: is-barrier
text: IS-Barrier is an intrinsically safe barrier developed in-house by Repos. It's built for Zone 0 installations.

label: ai-camera
text: The AI camera monitors the fuelling process.

label: engine
text: SMART#C helps keep engine RPM steady through the PTO.

label: communication
text: Secure Fuelling connects via BLE. OneSync can use WiFi or 4G.

label: catalog-names
text: OneSync, Secure Fueling, Data Link, R-ATG Ultrasonic, R-ATG Capacitance, SMART#C, R-CAM, IS-Barrier, Fire Shield, RFID.
